description: This file implements Express middleware functions for handling JWT-based authentication. It exports two functions: authMiddleware, which enforces authentication by verifying a Bearer token and attaching user info to the request, and optionalAuth, which allows a missing or invalid token, setting user info if present.

methods.name: authMiddleware(req, res, next)
methods.description: Express middleware that verifies a Bearer JWT from the Authorization header and attaches user info to req.

methods.name: optionalAuth(req, _res, next)
methods.description: Express middleware that optionally verifies a Bearer JWT, attaching user info if token is valid.
